ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-engagement screening of all General Partners, Limited Partners holding 25% or more, directors, and authorized signatories against: (i) the UN Consolidated Sanctions List; (ii) the UK HM Treasury/OFSI consolidated sanctions list as extended to Bermuda; (iii) the US OFAC SDN and Consolidated Non-SDN lists, being market-standard in Bermuda's correspondent banking environment; and (iv) designations under Bermuda's Anti-Terrorist Financing Act 2014. Screening is conducted pre-filing, refreshed at onboarding of the licensed CSP principal representative, and monitored on a rolling 24-hour negative-news basis via a commercial compliance database. Persons identified as Politically Exposed Persons at board or senior-executive level require senior management approval, enhanced due diligence, documented source-of-wealth substantiation, and ongoing transaction monitoring under the BMA Guidance Notes.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Bermuda Registry of Companies, Department of the Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Legal Affairs - Government of Bermuda e-Registry portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered name must be in English using the Roman alphabet; the name of an Exempted Limited Partnership must end with the words 'Limited Partnership' or the abbreviations 'LP' or 'L.P.'. Non-Roman script names, including Chinese trading names, must be accompanied by an English transliteration; the foreign-language name may be registered as a secondary trading name only if it does not create confusion with existing registered names. No translation of the legal form designation is accepted.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Extension: the applicant may request one additional 30-day reservation period prior to expiry upon payment of the applicable registry reservation fee; if the name expires, it reverts to the available pool and a fresh application is required. Rejection appeal: within 14 days of a written refusal, the applicant may file a formal reconsideration request with the Registrar of Companies, supplying a written memorandum distinguishing the proposed name from conflicting or prohibited registrations; if the Registrar maintains the refusal, the applicant may issue an originating summons to the Supreme Court of Bermuda under the Exempted Partnerships Act 1992 and Companies Act 1981 naming the Registrar as respondent. As a parallel remedy, a new application using a distinctive token, geographic qualifier, or unique registration number may be submitted immediately.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office not permitted for the statutory registered office: an Exempted Limited Partnership must maintain a physical registered office in Bermuda at the premises of a Bermuda-licensed corporate service provider, which also serves as the principal representative. A virtual or remote operational back-office abroad is acceptable solely for non-statutory commercial functions such as software engineering, product management, and user support. The statutory footprint in Bermuda must remain physical and staffed by the licensed CSP.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: less than 5% annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection by the Registrar or BMA directly at the ELP's statutory premises given a non-regulated social casino publishing profile with Apple IAP and Google Play Billing rails. However, the licensed CSP principal representative carries an approximately 10-20% annual probability of BMA AML/CFT on-site inspection, at which the ELP's UBO file, source-of-funds documentation, and commercial substance records may be examined. The inspection probability rises above 30% if the operation is re-characterized as gambling, digital asset business, payments, or a money service business.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Exempted Partnerships Act 1992 (Bermuda), as amended, ss. 4-7 and 29 (registration, effect of registration, name, and general partner requirements); Companies Act 1981, s. 253 (where the general partner is an overseas company); Limited Partnerships Act 1883 (residual rules).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda (filing via licensed Bermuda registered agents and the OneGov online portal).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital, no escrow account, and no capital duty or stamp duty on partnership capital; the Exempted Limited Partnership is formed with unlimited flexibility in capital contributions, but it must maintain a registered office in Bermuda and at least one general partner having a Bermuda presence (a Bermuda-incorporated company, a permitted overseas company, a Bermuda-registered limited partnership, or a Bermuda-resident individual).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the General Partner is hereby authorized to subscribe for the full partnership interest in the Exempted Limited Partnership to be established under the Exempted Partnerships Act 1992 of Bermuda, and to execute and file the Declaration of Limited Partnership with the Registrar of Companies; RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office be established at [●], Hamilton, Bermuda, and the licensed registered agent be appointed as resident agent and registrar; RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] be appointed principal General Partner and [Name] Chief Operating Officer, each authorized to open bank accounts, sign platform agreements, appoint tax counsel, and effect all ancillary filings; and all actions taken in furtherance of these resolutions are ratified and confirmed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name search for the exempted limited partnership (name must end with Limited Partnership or L.P.), the proposed general partner, and the commercial brand for the social casino platform; obtain a name reservation valid for 60 days before filing the Declaration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Either incorporate a new Bermuda exempted company to act as general partner (no minimum capital, no escrow) or register an existing overseas company under Companies Act 1981 s. 253; execute the constitutional documents, appoint directors and secretary, and obtain the Certificate of Incorporation.

Certificate of Incorporation or s. 253 registration
Registered office consent of the agent
KYC and beneficial ownership declarations of the general partner

Certified copy of the general partner's Certificate of Incorporation

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Bermuda Office of the Tax Commissioner, Ministry of Finance; official portal https://www.gov.bm/department/office-tax-commissioner
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity establishing an Exempted Limited Partnership files registration forms under the Exempted Partnerships Act 2009 with the Registrar of Companies, obtaining a Certificate of Limited Partnership and a partnership registration number. If the partnership employs staff in Bermuda, it must separately register with the Tax Commissioner for payroll tax; no general corporate TIN is issued because Bermuda levies no income tax on foreign-owned exempted partnerships.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Pass_Through_Eligible; the ELP is fiscally transparent, with partners taxed only on Bermuda-source payroll and land holdings; no entity-level income tax applies.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Bermuda has no domestic check-the-box or fiscal transparency election. Partners may elect separate legal personality under Section 12 of the Exempted Partnerships Act; foreign hybrid treatment (e.g., US check-the-box) is available solely under foreign tax law and has no Bermuda domestic tax effect.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Customs Duties and Stamp Duties (no VAT/GST system)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable; Bermuda has no VAT/GST registration threshold. Importers of dutiable goods must obtain a customs broker accreditation and pay applicable customs duties at time of clearance.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing or fiscal clearance mandate for VAT. Bermuda Customs Service uses ASYCUDA World for electronic submission of import/export declarations; no real-time fiscal API or digital stamping required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable; Bermuda does not impose VAT/GST on goods or services. Goods exported from Bermuda are outside the scope of customs duties, which apply only to imports; offshore services are not subject to Bermuda indirect tax.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration via ASYCUDA World
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
Inward Remittance Certificate (only where foreign currency repatriation evidence is requested)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Penalties for false export declarations arise under the Customs Tariff Act 1980, including fines up to $10,000 and forfeiture of goods. Because no VAT exists, there is no VAT clawback mechanism; however, payroll tax non-compliance (e.g., failure to remit employee deductions) attracts separate penalties, interest, and recovery action by the Tax Commissioner.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA), established under the Bermuda Monetary Authority Act 1969, acting as the statutory financial services regulator, central monetary institution, and supervisory authority for foreign exchange and clearing conduct in Bermuda. The Bank of England (BoE) exercises sovereign monetary oversight over the United Kingdom only and holds no exchange-control authority over Bermuda, a British Overseas Territory with fiscal autonomy.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Bermudian dollar (BMD) is pegged at a fixed 1:1 parity to the US dollar (USD) by statute. Bermuda maintains no exchange-control legislation; both current-account and capital-account transactions are fully convertible without official approval. Profit remittance, partner distributions, liquidation proceeds, and intra-group disbursements from an Exempted Limited Partnership (ELP) are unrestricted in any freely usable currency. The United Kingdom likewise operates a fully liberalised, exchange-control-free capital regime following the repeal of the Exchange Control Act 1979, creating a fully fungible GBP/USD corridor for the UK parent and Bermuda ELP. The only practical hurdles are AML/ATF documentation, sanctions screening, and the BMA's economic substance and beneficial ownership reporting obligations, none of which restricts convertibility.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender rules exist in Bermuda or the United Kingdom. The ELP is not required to repatriate, convert, or surrender any percentage of export receipts, including Apple App Store and Google Play settlement inflows. Settlement proceeds may be retained indefinitely in USD, converted to GBP at commercial rate, or held in multi-currency accounts at Bermuda-licensed banks at the sole discretion of the General Partner. No central-bank conversion ratio, mandated timeline, or balance-sheet ceiling applies.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-Low feasibility for cross-border use of FinTech Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs). UK-licensed EMIs such as Wise, Revolut Business, and Modulr permit remote multi-currency account opening, but their automated underwriting engines frequently classify ISIC 5820 software publishers with virtual slots/social casino mechanics as gambling-adjacent high risk, resulting in upward of 30-60% policy-decline probability at application stage. EMIs that do approve typically impose monthly volume ceilings, transaction velocity caps, and recurring Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) reviews. Legal viability is nevertheless defensible because a simulated social casino product with no real-money wagering, no cash-in/cash-out, and no prize redemption does not constitute licensable gambling services under the UK Gambling Act 2005; however, EMIs can lawfully decline based on independent internal business-risk appetite. Bermuda itself has no standalone EMI licence category, so the ELP must rely on full Bermuda-licensed banks as primary treasury counterparties and may use UK EMIs only as secondary settlement rails after obtaining written compliance pre-approval.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Bermuda-licensed banks (HSBC, Butterfield, Clarien) generally mandate a physical onboarding interview for the General Partner and any authorised signatories or, alternatively, accept a remote opening package comprising L3-certified electronic identity verification, a notarised certified-copy passport and proof-of-address issued by a UK-regulated notary, and a banker's reference from an approved introducing institution. UK-domiciled banks and UK-licensed EMIs permit fully remote video-KYC onboarding under FCA electronic verification rules. Recommended hybrid path: conduct the primary Bermuda account opening through an in-person director meeting (or an existing-banker introduction) while concurrently opening a remote UK GBP/USD treasury account for day-to-day operational disbursements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Industry-code red flag: ISIC 5820 / NAICS 511210 (Software Publishing) mapped to virtual slots and social casino simulation is auto-classified by bank screening engines as gambling, triggering automated refusal or mandatory High-Risk Customer designation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Furnish (i) a formal legal opinion from UK counsel confirming the product qualifies as a simulated social casino with zero real-money wagering, no monetary prizes, and no exchangeable virtual currency; (ii) a Gambling Act 2005 Section 3 analysis demonstrating that betting, gaming, and lottery definitions are not engaged; (iii) confirmation from the Bermuda Casino Licensing Commission that no Bermuda gaming licence is required; (iv) Responsible Gambling and player-protection policies; (v) geo-blocking certification for prohibited territories; and (vi) App Store and Google Play category approvals evidencing 'simulated gaming' classification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume micro-transaction pattern: recurring low-value USD payments from Apple IAP and Google Play Billing (typically under USD 10 per ticket) create chargeback, refund, and aggregate-velocity risk that may breach bank exposure thresholds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide (i) two rolling months of Apple Payments and Google Payments settlement statements reconciled line-by-line to proposed bank entries; (ii) chargeback ratio attestation below 0.75% verified by the merchant-of-record's acquiring bank; (iii) PCI-DSS Level 1 attestation of compliance; (iv) formal refund and dispute management procedure; (v) expected transaction-velocity model covering daily ticket counts, peak-hour loads, and customer-concentration limits; and (vi) a written commitment to monthly EDD reporting.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex offshore chain-of-ownership: a Bermuda Exempted Limited Partnership with a UK General Partner and non-resident foreign Limited Partners creates UBO identification doubt and layered-ownership suspicion under the BMA AML/ATF Module 3.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver (i) Certificate of Registration and current Partnership Extract from the BMA; (ii) completed Declaration of Ultimate Beneficial Ownership and Control signed by the General Partner; (iii) executed Partnership Agreement including the full capital schedule of every Limited Partner and their proportional entitlements; (iv) source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements for each partner contributing more than 10% of committed capital, certified by the introducing bank or a regulated professional; and (v) notarised consent letters from each Limited Partner acknowledging the bank's CDD rights.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and prohibited-jurisdiction nexus: virtual slots user traffic may originate from OFAC-sanctioned or UK-embargoed territories, exposing the bank to secondary sanctions and enabling-risk liability.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit (i) a technical certification from the app publisher confirming IP, device, and storefront-level geo-blocking of Crimea, the Donetsk and Luhansk regions, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Syria, and any additional OFAC/UK-embargoed destinations; (ii) storefront distribution list restricted to the United Kingdom, permitted EEA/EFTA states, and other approved territories; (iii) internal sanctions-screening procedure applicable to all manual refunds, chargebacks, or any outbound treasury payments; (iv) copy of the due-diligence questionnaire completed for Apple and Google attesting to compliance with export-control law; and (v) semi-annual sanctions-programme review commitment to the bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Merchant-of-Record ambiguity: because settlement originates solely from Apple and Google rather than directly from consumers, banks may question whether the ELP is the true merchant, triggering AML expectation-duty concerns and possible money-flow rejection.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide (i) executed Publisher-of-Record and settlement-assignment agreements between the ELP, the UK publishing affiliate, and Apple/Google; (ii) treasury flow diagram demonstrating store settlement in USD to the ELP-controlled account; (iii) written merchant-of-record confirmation letters from the acquiring banks or PSPs; (iv) statutory declarations from the General Partner confirming no player-to-player transfers and no player-to-fiat withdrawal rails exist; and (v) consolidated group structure chart certified by the Bermuda registered agent to evidence full transparency of all payment flows.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections from the UK parent or Limited Partners must be executed by SWIFT MT103 credit transfer in GBP or USD to the ELP's designated account at HSBC Bank Bermuda Limited or Butterfield Bank. Remittance instruction Field 70 must state 'CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION / ELP PARTNERSHIP CONTRIBUTION' together with the BMA-registered ELP number; Field 72T is used to append the beneficiary identifier and reference to the Capital Contribution Schedule. USD transfers route via Fedwire/CHIPS through Butterfield's New York correspondent or HSBC's New York clearing branch; GBP transfers route via CHAPS to the bank's London correspondent. Amounts exceeding USD 50,000 per instruction are supported by a General Partner resolution and an updated capital schedule, and the bank's FX desk confirms no mandatory conversion into BMD given the fixed 1:1 peg; funds are maintained in USD ledger currency to match Apple/Google settlement receipts. For FATCA/CRS purposes, the remittance narrative must include the UK parent's UTR and the ELP's BMA reference to avoid disclosure mismatches.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements are cleared through three complementary rails: (i) operational supplier, royalty, and licence payments via SWIFT MT103 customer credit transfers priced in GBP through CHAPS or Faster Payments, with supporting invoices attached for all individual disbursements above USD 15,000; (ii) large-scale development or content-licensing agreements via commercial documentary Letters of Credit issued under SWIFT MT700 and governed by UCP600, with confirmation by a top-25 UK clearing bank where counterparty credit risk justifies confirmation; and (iii) treasury concentration via HSBC Bermudas dual-currency notional pooling engine, enabling USD and GBP end-of-day sweeps into a single interest-bearing ledger. Apple Payments and Google Payments USD settlements are received directly into the ELP's USD account through the app-store merchant settlement network; any forced currency conversion is limited to the pool bank's posted commercial rate. All outbound messages are sanctions-screened against BMA, OFAC, and UK HMT lists.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla FX forwards with tenors up to 12 months for hedging GBP/USD exposures arising from UK publishing royalties and UK parent disbursements, executed on an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement with a Bermuda-licensed bank counterparty and settled by physical delivery in GBP/USD.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) limited to emergent-market settlement currencies indirectly embedded in Google Play consumer flows (including BRL, MXN, and TRY), booked only with tier-1 global bank counterparts, cash-settled in USD, and mandated to match the forecast settlement settlement lag.

Cross-currency swaps (CCS) for matched-maturity transformation of a material GBP-denominated capital repatriation or dividend stream against the USD IAP settlement curve, with principal exchange executed at maturity only and no speculative unwind permitted without bank approval.
Zero-cost collars and vanilla FX options permitted solely for downside protection of incremental GBP disbursement requirements, with option expiry aligned to known quarterly cash-flow cycles.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Exempted Partnership Annual Return and Government Fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 January of each calendar year, covering the annual obligation for the current calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late fee of US$300 is imposed after 31 January; continued non-payment may result in revocation of exempted status, ministerial declaration, and strike-off from the Register of Companies after publication in the Official Gazette.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Economic Substance Declaration (if the exempted partnership qualifies as a relevant entity under the Economic Substance Act 2018)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies / Bermuda Economic Substance Authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the end of the exempted partnership's accounting period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file is an offence subject to penalties up to BMD 250,000; knowingly making a false declaration carries imprisonment up to 10 years on conviction. The Registrar may also require a further declaration, production of records, or audited accounts in cases of suspected non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Register Update and Annual Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies via the Beneficial Ownership Register platform
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Changes in registrable beneficial owners must be reported within 30 days of the change; annual confirmation is aligned with the Bermuda annual fee and return window ending 31 January
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance is an offence with fines up to BMD 25,000 on conviction, continuing default penalties up to BMD 5,000 per day, and potential strike-off for persistent failure to file required returns.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Bermuda exempted partnerships are not automatically subject to statutory audit based on revenue or asset thresholds. A mandatory independent audit is triggered only where the partnership is a regulated investment fund under the Investment Funds Act 2006, holds a licence issued by the Bermuda Monetary Authority, or is otherwise required by the BMA, the partnership agreement, or investor engagement terms.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No Bermuda GAAP is prescribed for exempted partnerships; financial statements, when required, are generally prepared in accordance with IFRS or US GAAP as stipulated in the partnership agreement or by the relevant regulator.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: An exempted partnership that is a relevant entity under the Beneficial Ownership Act 2017 must maintain a register of beneficial owners at its registered office. Partnership interest transfers are recorded in the partner registers and reported to the Beneficial Ownership Register platform within 30 days of the transfer. No standalone annual UBO re-filing is required; the annual return certifies that the registered beneficial ownership information is current and accurate as at the date of filing.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$2,500 to US$6,500 per year, depending on the Bermuda registered office provider and resident agent service scope
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$10,000 to US$25,000 for a non-regulated exempted partnership with clean unaudited records; a regulated investment fund or mandatory audit engagement may exceed US$35,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% under Bermuda's ordinary tax system for an exempted limited partnership; 15% under the Bermuda Corporate Income Tax Act 2023 (CITA) only if the ELP is an in-scope Bermuda Business Entity that is a constituent entity of an MNE group with consolidated revenue of at least EUR 750 million.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966 shields a certified exempted ELP from any future Bermuda tax on profits, dividends, capital gains, interest and distributions until 2035. The social-casino publishing activity itself confers no preferential corporate tax rate; the only routine Bermuda fiscal cost for an out-of-scope ELP is the annual exempted partnership government fee.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Return (designated CIT-1 on the Bermuda Ministry of Finance CIT Online Filing Portal) for in-scope CITA entities; out-of-scope Bermuda ELPs are not required to file a CIT-1 and only remain subject to the exempted partnership annual declaration through the Bermuda Registrar of Companies' online filing system.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: CIT-1 is due within 12 months after the end of the ELP's fiscal year; the exempted partnership annual declaration is due on or before the anniversary date prescribed by the Registrar of Companies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Bermuda registered number, CITA constituent-entity reference, ultimate parent entity identifier, and fiscal year-end.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Out-of-scope non-resident partners should not submit a CIT-1; in-scope entities must also report the GloBE/MNE group UPE jurisdiction and tax identification number.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reconcile financial accounting net income or loss to Bermuda taxable income, including adjustments for dividends, equity gains, covered income exclusions, and tax elections.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the ELP relies on the EUR 750 million group-revenue threshold exclusion, a written confirmation and the audited group revenue figure should be maintained in the TP file rather than filed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Schedule B - QDMTT Top-Up Tax Calculation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Compute the Bermuda Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-Up Tax using the GloBE effective tax rate and jurisdictional top-up percentage.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Complete only where the ELP is part of an in-scope MNE group; otherwise mark as not applicable and provide supporting exclusion computation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Schedule C - Related-Party Transactions and Transfer Pricing
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disclose cross-border software licensing, in-app purchase support, management fees, shareholder advances, and any intergroup DEMPE cost allocations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners must ensure arm's length pricing and retain an OECD-compliant Local File in Bermuda; the CIT portal requires declaration of the controlled transaction value.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing and non-filing penalties for in-scope CIT entities include an initial fixed penalty of BMD 10,000, a daily surcharge of BMD 1,000, and additional civil penalties of up to 100% of understated CIT; false declarations also attract fraud penalties, de-registration of exempted status, and criminal prosecution.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Bermuda ELP Annual Declaration (Exempted Limited Partnership Annual Return) submitted by the registered agent through the Bermuda Registrar of Companies' online portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annually before the ELP's registration anniversary; an extension is generally available for not more than 60 calendar days where a valid reason is certified by the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - ELP Name and Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name exactly as registered and the Bermuda ELP certificate number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the same legal name reflected in the Cayman/Bermuda corporate register and any CITA registration records; do not use trade names.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 - Registered Office and Principal Place of Business
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Bermuda registered office address and any principal administrative address where gaming IP management occurs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An out-of-scope ELP with no Bermuda premises should state its registered agent's address only and attach the economic substance exemption worksheet.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 - General Partner and Partner Details
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identity of the general partner, limited partners' ownership percentages, and ultimate beneficial owners.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident ownership scenario, provide a copy of the partnership agreement and confirm that no Bermuda-resident partner controls the ELP.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of whether the ELP is exempted from CIT under the exemption certificate and whether it has met the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection conditions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm no CIT registration is required; if a later change of in-scope status occurs, the ELP must register before the effective date or face retrospective penalty.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late annual declaration attracts a BMD 100 per day late fee, suspension of the ELP's certificate, and possible administrative strike-off; restoration costs and removal of tax protection follow repeated non-compliance.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Bermuda imposes no dividend withholding tax and no withholding tax on partnership distributions to non-resident partners.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No comprehensive double-taxation agreement (DTA) extends to Bermuda, so conventional DTA withholding-relief procedures do not apply. A non-resident partner claiming relief in its own residence country must obtain a certificate of the nil Bermudian tax position and, where necessary, a Bermuda Tax Information Exchange Act confirmation; the practical relief mechanism is a unilateral foreign tax credit in the partner's home jurisdiction rather than treaty-reduced source-state withholding.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% domestic Bermuda withholding tax on cross-border royalties and interest. No treaty-lowered rate is available because Bermuda has no income-tax treaty network. For in-scope CIT entities, cross-border interest and royalty deductions are permitted only to the extent of an arm's length economic substance analysis; excessive or artificial payments may be disallowed and recharacterised.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Master File and Local File arise for a Bermuda ELP when the MNE group has consolidated annual revenue of at least EUR 750 million (approximately BMD 1,000,000,000 at parity-adjusted threshold) and any Bermuda controlled transaction exceeds BMD 5,000,000 in the fiscal year; an out-of-scope ELP that engages in related-party digital gaming transactions should nonetheless maintain an OECD-compliant TP file as defensive documentation.
